_meta.description: Seed library of Star Wars: Legion keywords for the app's rules engine and card viewer.
_meta.source_notes: Descriptions are paraphrased summaries for gameplay reference, not verbatim rulebook text. Always defer to the official Core Rulebook / Errata Reference for tournament-legal rulings.
_meta.rules_baseline: 2024 Core Rulebook Refresh (v2.6.0), updated through the April 2026 Development Update
_meta.verification_status: PARTIAL VERIFICATION PASS on 2026-08-22 against legionquickguide.com (fan-maintained but tracks the live Core Rulebook, effective 5.29.2026). Keywords A-D were cross-checked directly against that source; corrections and additions from that pass are marked verified=true with a verification_note. Everything else (E-Z) still traces back to the original fan-wiki-based draft and is marked verified=false -- treat those as unconfirmed until a follow-up pass checks them against the current rules. KEYWORD-RESOLUTION PASS on 2026-08-23: added 55 new entries to resolve raw printed keyword strings from the 2026-08-23 card-extraction batches (data/units.json) against this library -- 44 sourced from swgametools.gyozaguy.com/legion/keywords (marked verified=true) or a corroborated secondary source, 11 left as honest verified=false placeholders where no rules text could be found (Combat Shield, Death from Above, Distract, Hold the Line, Hunted, "I'm Part of the Squad Too", Infinite Power, Interrogate, One Step Ahead, Small, Weighed Down). See db/seed.rs::resolve_keyword_id for the mechanical raw-string-to-id resolver and its `cargo test -- --nocapture unresolved_keywords` diagnostic.

keywords.name: AI: [Action]
keywords.description: If the unit has no faceup order token, it must attempt one of its listed actions as part of its Make Action step when it's suppressed, has a vehicle damage token, or (for vehicles) has lost half or more of its starting minis. If it can't take a listed action, it makes one fewer action that step.
